modes.title: Lineup Modes
modes.remarks: Specifies the plant modes in which the lineups associated with this lineup plan can be completed.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The person group responsible for this lineup plan.

type.title: Type
type.remarks: Identifies the type of lineup: template or working. All lineup plans are the template type, and all lineups are the working type. You use lineup plans to create working lineups. You use working lineups to execute lineups in the field.

reference.title: Source
reference.remarks: Specifies the type of document, object, or event on which the configuration details in this lineup plan are based.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Identifies the site to which this lineup plan applies.

history.title: History
history.remarks: Indicates whether this is a historical record.

eqtype.title: Equipment Type
eqtype.remarks: Specifies the type of equipment that is managed in this lineup plan. In this context, the term equipment can refer to assets or locations.

unit.title: Unit
unit.remarks: The unit to which this lineup plan or lineup applies.

revdesc.title: Revision Description
revdesc.remarks: A brief description on the reason of this revision.

outagecode.title: Outage Code
outagecode.remarks: Specifies the outage and outage type associated with this lineup plan.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the lineup plan.

createddate.title: Date Created
createddate.remarks: The date on which the lineup plan was created.

schedulecode.title: Schedule Code
schedulecode.remarks: Indicates when work associated with this lineup plan can take place. Typically, schedule codes indicate whether work can take place while the nuclear power plant is online or during a planned outage.

revnum.title: Revision
revnum.remarks: The revision of the current lineup plan.

duration.title: Duration
duration.remarks: The estimated number of hours required to complete a lineup that is based on the main component list in the lineup plan.

mer.title: Mode Entry Requirement
mer.remarks: Indicates that the lineup must be completed before entering the specified plant mode. The requirement only applies when entering the plant mode in the stated direction (A stands for ascending, D stands for descending).

revdate.title: Revision Date
revdate.remarks: The date on which the specified revision of the lineup plan takes effect.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: The person responsible for this lineup plan.

classstructureid.title: Class Structure
classstructureid.remarks: Identifies the class structure for this lineup plan or lineup.

remdur.title: Remaining Duration
remdur.remarks: The remaining number of hours required to complete the lineup.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date on which the status of the lineup plan was changed.

milestone.title: Milestone Code
milestone.remarks: Specifies the plant operational milestone associated with this lineup plan.

resttype.title: Restoration Condition
resttype.remarks: The restoration condition for which default restoration positions on this lineup plan are defined. When the status of the lineup plan changes to Active, any default restoration positions that are defined on the record are added to the relevant component records. The specified positions are then available for selection during clearance restoration. Only one active lineup plan at a time can specify a default restoration position for a given component and restoration condition.
